## Partner Map

Every AXUDP peer GB7CAM is configured to reach, not only the ones answering at
this moment. That distinction matters: the node carries far more configured
peers than are up at any instant, and a map of only the live ones would flatter
the network.

Colour is how long each link has been up without a break, so a peer added last
week is not marked down for being new. Grey with a dashed line means configured
but not linked right now, and the table below the map gives the last time each
of those was seen. Positions are supplied by the operators; where none is known
the station is drawn hollow at the centre of its country rather than guessed at.

<style>
.pm-legend { font-family:sans-serif; font-size:0.82em; color:#555; display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:6px 0 10px; }
.pm-legend span::before { content:""; display:inline-block; width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:50%; margin-right:5px; vertical-align:-1px; }

  <span class="pm-7">Three days</span>

  <span class="pm-0">Under a day</span>

<!-- Not id="partner-map": Quarto slugs the "## Partner Map" heading to
     <section id="partner-map">, and getElementById would return the whole
     section. Writing the SVG into it wiped the section, heading included. -->
<div id="pm-canvas" style="border:1px solid #ddd; background:#ffffff;"><p class="status-note">Loading map.</p></div>

<div id="pm-down"><p class="status-note">Loading partner detail.</p></div>

<script>
(function () {
  const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk";
  const W = 1000, H = 500;

  // Equirectangular. land.json holds [lon, lat] pairs in degrees, from Natural
  // Earth 110m, which is public domain.
  const px = (lon, lat) => [ (lon + 180) / 360 * W, (90 - lat) / 180 * H ];

  const band = st => {
    if (!st.live) return "#adb5bd";
    const d = st.linked_days;
    if (d === null || d === undefined) return "#adb5bd";
    // Bands match the HAMNET map. Thirty days was unreachable: the record
    // starts 24 July and any linbpq restart resets every streak, so nothing
    // was ever green and a healthy three day link drew amber.
    if (d >= 7) return "#2f9e44";
    if (d >= 3) return "#74b816";
    if (d >= 1) return "#f59f00";
    return "#e03131";
  };
  const humanDays = d => {
    if (d === null || d === undefined) return "";
    if (d < 1) return Math.max(1, Math.round(d * 24)) + " h";
    if (d < 60) return Math.floor(d) + " d";
    return Math.floor(d / 30.4) + " months";
  };
  // Tolerates a missing element. Quarto can drop an empty raw div, and one
  // absent container should not take the whole map down with it.
  const put = (id, html) => {
    const e = document.getElementById(id);
    if (e) { e.innerHTML = html; } else { console.warn("missing element: " + id); }
  };
  const esc = t => String(t).replace(/[<>&"]/g, c =>
    ({ "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", "&": "&amp;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));

  Promise.all([
    fetch("data/land.json").then(r => r.json()),
    fetch(API + "/partners").then(r => r.json())
  ]).then(([land, data]) => {
    const out = [];
    out.push(`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Map of GB7CAM partner stations">`);
    out.push(`<rect width="${W}" height="${H}" fill="#f7fafc"/>`);
    for (const ring of land) {
      const d = ring.map((p, i) => (i ? "L" : "M") + px(p[0], p[1]).map(v => v.toFixed(1)).join(" ")).join("");
      out.push(`<path d="${d}Z" fill="#e8eef5" stroke="#d4dde8" stroke-width="0.6"/>`);
    }

    const home = px(data.home.lon, data.home.lat);
    for (const st of data.stations) {
      const p = px(st.lon, st.lat);
      out.push(`<line x1="${home[0].toFixed(1)}" y1="${home[1].toFixed(1)}" x2="${p[0].toFixed(1)}" y2="${p[1].toFixed(1)}" stroke="${st.live ? "#4dabf7" : "#adb5bd"}" stroke-width="1" opacity="${st.live ? 0.42 : 0.3}"${st.live ? "" : ' stroke-dasharray="3 3"'}/>`);
    }
    for (const st of data.stations) {
      const p = px(st.lon, st.lat);
      const r = 3 + Math.sqrt(st.nodes || 0) * 0.22;
      const where = st.place || (st.country + " (country only)");
      const when = st.live ? "linked " + humanDays(st.linked_days) : "not linked";
      const fill = st.exact ? band(st) : "none";
      out.push(`<circle cx="${p[0].toFixed(1)}" cy="${p[1].toFixed(1)}" r="${r.toFixed(2)}" fill="${fill}" stroke="${band(st)}" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.85"><title>${esc(st.call)} · ${esc(where)} · ${st.nodes} nodes · ${esc(when)}</title></circle>`);
    }
    out.push(`<circle cx="${home[0].toFixed(1)}" cy="${home[1].toFixed(1)}" r="5" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.4"><title>${esc(data.home.call)} · ${esc(data.home.place)} · ${esc(data.home.locator)}</title></circle>`);
    out.push("</svg>");
    put("pm-canvas", out.join(""));

    const down = data.stations.filter(s => s.configured && !s.live);
    put("pm-down", down.length === 0
      ? '<p class="status-note">Every configured peer is linked.</p>'
      : '<table class="pm-down-table"><thead><tr><th>Configured but not linked</th><th>Where</th><th>Seen in</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
        + down.map(s => `<tr><td>${esc(s.call)}</td><td>${esc(s.place || s.country)}</td><td>${s.since_pct === null ? "&ndash;" : s.since_pct + "% of snapshots"}</td></tr>`).join("")
        + "</tbody></table>");
  }).catch(err => {
    // Say which stage failed. Reporting "unavailable" for a rendering bug
    // sent us looking at the data, which was fine.
    console.error("partner map:", err);
    put("pm-canvas", '<p class="status-note">Partner map unavailable: '
        + esc(err && err.message ? err.message : err) + '</p>');
  });

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Health rollup, from the same /metrics the HAMNET status page reads.
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  const parseMetrics = text => {
    const out = {};
    for (const line of text.split("\n")) {
      if (!line || line[0] === "#") continue;
      const sp = line.lastIndexOf(" ");
      if (sp < 0) continue;
      const key = line.slice(0, sp), val = parseFloat(line.slice(sp + 1));
      let name = key, labels = {};
      const br = key.indexOf("{");
      if (br > -1) {
        name = key.slice(0, br);
        key.slice(br + 1, key.lastIndexOf("}")).replace(
          /([a-zA-Z_]+)="((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"/g, (_, k, v) => { labels[k] = v; return ""; });
      }
      (out[name] = out[name] || []).push({ labels, value: val });
    }
    return out;
  };

  Promise.all([
    fetch(API + "/metrics").then(r => r.text()).then(parseMetrics),
    fetch(API + "/partners").then(r => r.json())
  ]).then(([m, data]) => {
    const problems = [];

    const services = m.gb7cam_service_up || [];
    const dead = services.filter(s => !s.value).map(s => s.labels.unit);
    if (dead.length) problems.push("service down: " + dead.join(", "));

    const routes = {};
    (m.gb7cam_routes_total || []).forEach(s => { routes[s.labels.source] = s.value; });
    if (!routes.hamnet) problems.push("no HAMNET routes");
    if (!routes.amprnet) problems.push("no AMPRNet routes");
    document.getElementById("w-uplinks").innerText =
      `HAMNET ${(routes.hamnet || 0).toLocaleString()} · AMPRNet ${(routes.amprnet || 0).toLocaleString()}`;

    const conf = data.stations.filter(s => s.configured);
    const live = conf.filter(s => s.live);
    const downNames = conf.filter(s => !s.live).map(s => s.call);
    document.getElementById("w-peers").innerText = `${live.length} of ${conf.length} linked`;
    if (conf.length && live.length / conf.length < 0.8) {
      problems.push(`only ${live.length} of ${conf.length} peers linked`);
    }

    let age = 0;
    (m.gb7cam_cache_age_seconds || []).forEach(s => { if (s.value > age) age = s.value; });
    if (age > 900) problems.push(`node figures ${Math.round(age / 60)} minutes stale`);

    const el = document.getElementById("api-status-widget");
    el.classList.remove("status-card--good", "status-card--bad");
    el.classList.add(problems.length ? "status-card--bad" : "status-card--good");
    document.getElementById("w-status").innerText = problems.length ? "Degraded" : "Operational";

    document.getElementById("w-why").innerText = problems.length
      ? "Reason: " + problems.join("; ") + "."
      : (downNames.length
         ? "All checks pass. Configured but not linked right now: " + downNames.join(", ") + "."
         : "All checks pass.");

    document.getElementById("w-fresh").innerText =
      `Node figures come from the collector cache, oldest entry ${Math.round(age)} s old. Uplink and service figures are read live.`;
  }).catch(() => {
    document.getElementById("w-why").innerText =
      "Status detail unavailable: the node's metrics endpoint could not be reached.";
  });
})();
</script>

  <p>Loading routing node index...</p>

<script>
let allNodes = [];

/* ----------------------------
   CONSTANTS
---------------------------- */
const RF_PORT = 1;
const AXIP_PORT = 3;
const WINDOW_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

/* ----------------------------
   HELPERS
---------------------------- */
function parseTime(st) {
  if (!st?.lastHeard) return NaN;

  const [datePart, timePart] = st.lastHeard.split(" ");
  if (!datePart || !timePart) return NaN;

  const [y, m, d] = datePart.split("-").map(Number);
  const [hh, mm, ss = 0] = timePart.split(":").map(Number);

  return Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d, hh, mm, ss);
}

function formatUTC(ts) {
  return new Date(ts)
    .toISOString()
    .substring(0, 19)
    .replace("T", " ") + " UTC";
}

/* ----------------------------
   FETCH DATA
---------------------------- */
async function fetchDashboardData() {
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("api-status-widget");

  function setOffline() {
    statusEl.classList.remove("status-card--good", "status-card--bad");
    statusEl.classList.add("status-card--bad");

    document.getElementById("w-status").innerText = "Offline";
    document.getElementById("w-peers").innerText = "—";
    document.getElementById("w-links").innerText = "—";
    document.getElementById("w-rf").innerText = "—";
    document.getElementById("w-last").innerText = "No data";
  }

  const base = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk";

  try {
    const [linksRes, mheardRes, nodesRes, portsRes, routesRes] = await Promise.all([
      fetch(base + "/links"),
      fetch(base + "/mheard/all"),
      fetch(base + "/nodes"),
      fetch(base + "/ports"),
      fetch(base + "/routes")
    ]);

    if (!linksRes.ok || !mheardRes.ok || !nodesRes.ok || !portsRes.ok) {
      setOffline();
      return;
    }

    /* Read every body exactly ONCE - a Response body cannot be read twice,
       and the routes JSON is needed again further down for the routes table.
       /routes returns its data as raw_text_lines (one string per route,
       "port call quality nodecount"), not a `routes` array.
       /links is usually right but can go stale until linbpq is restarted. */
    const links = (await linksRes.json()).links || [];
    const routesJson = routesRes.ok ? await routesRes.json().catch(() => ({})) : {};
    const routes = routesJson.raw_text_lines || routesJson.routes || [];
    const rawMheard = (await mheardRes.json()).mheard || [];
    allNodes = (await nodesRes.json()).nodes || [];
    const ports = (await portsRes.json()).ports || [];
    const cutoff = Date.now() - WINDOW_MS;

    const mheardAll = rawMheard
      .map(st => ({ ...st, ts: parseTime(st) }))
      .filter(st => !isNaN(st.ts) && st.ts >= cutoff)
      .sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts);

    /* ----------------------------
       ACTIVITY FEED
    ---------------------------- */
    document.getElementById("activity-feed-container").innerHTML =
      mheardAll.length === 0
        ? `<p class="text-muted">No recent activity</p>`
        : mheardAll.map(st => {
            const port = Number(st.port);
            return `
              <div class="activity-item">
                🕒 ${formatUTC(st.ts)}
                <span class="${port === RF_PORT ? "port--rf" : "port--axip"}">
                  Heard ${st.callSign}
                </span>
                on Port ${st.port}
              </div>`;
          }).join("");

    /* ----------------------------
       PORTS
    ---------------------------- */
    const portsEl = document.getElementById("ports-container");
    portsEl.innerHTML = `
    <table class="table-dashboard">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Port</th>
          <th>Description</th>
          <th>Driver</th>
          <th>State</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${ports.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td class="${Number(p.Number) === RF_PORT ? "port--rf" : Number(p.Number) === AXIP_PORT ? "port--axip" : "port--neutral"}">
              ${p.Number}
            </td>
            <td>${p.ID}</td>
            <td>${p.Driver}</td>
            <td>${p.State}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join("")}
      </tbody>
    </table>`;

    /* ----------------------------
       LINKS
    ---------------------------- */
    document.getElementById("links-container").innerHTML =
      links.length === 0
        ? "<p>No active links</p>"
        : `
    <table class="table-dashboard">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Node</th>
          <th>Port</th>
          <th>Type</th>
          <th>Status</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${links.map(l => {
          const up = ["ACTIVE","ESTABLISHED","CONNECTED"].includes((l.state||"").toUpperCase());
          const portClass = Number(l.port) === RF_PORT ? "port--rf" : "port--axip";
          return `
            <tr>
              <td>${l.farCall}</td>
              <td class="${portClass}">${l.port}</td>
              <td>${l.linkType || "AXUDP"}</td>
              <td>
                <span class="status-pill ${up ? "status-pill--good" : "status-pill--bad"}">
                  ${l.state || "ACTIVE"}
                </span>
              </td>
            </tr>`;
        }).join("")}
      </tbody>
    </table>`;

    /* ----------------------------
       MHEARD
    ---------------------------- */
    document.getElementById("mheard-container").innerHTML =
      mheardAll.length === 0
        ? "<p>No stations</p>"
        : `
    <table class="table-dashboard">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Call</th>
          <th>Port</th>
          <th>Packets</th>
          <th>Last Heard</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${mheardAll.map(st => {
          const portClass = Number(st.port) === RF_PORT ? "port--rf" : "port--axip";
          return `
            <tr>
              <td>${st.callSign}</td>
              <td class="${portClass}">${st.port}</td>
              <td>${Number(st.packets||0).toLocaleString()}</td>
              <td>${formatUTC(st.ts)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        }).join("")}
      </tbody>
    </table>`;

    /* ----------------------------
       TELNET ROUTES INTERPRETER
    ---------------------------- */
    if (routesRes.ok) {
      /* routesJson was already read above - do NOT call routesRes.json()
         again here, the body stream can only be consumed once. */
      const routeLines = routes;

      const parsedRoutes = routeLines.map(line => {
        const tokens = line.trim().split(/\s+/);
        if (tokens.length >= 4) {
          return { port: tokens[0], call: tokens[1], quality: tokens[2], nodes: tokens[3] };
        }
        return null;
      }).filter(Boolean);

      document.getElementById("routes-container").innerHTML = parsedRoutes.length === 0
        ? "<p class='text-muted'>No console routes populated</p>"
        : `
      <table class="table-dashboard">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Destination Node</th>
            <th>Outgoing Port</th>
            <th>Link Quality</th>
            <th>Nodes</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          ${parsedRoutes.map(r => {
            const pClass = Number(r.port) === RF_PORT ? "port--rf" : Number(r.port) === AXIP_PORT ? "port--axip" : "port--neutral";
            return `
              <tr>
                <td style="font-weight:bold;">${r.call}</td>
                <td class="${pClass}">${r.port}</td>
                <td>${r.quality}</td>
                <td>${r.nodes}</td>
              </tr>`;
          }).join("")}
        </tbody>
      </table>`;
    }

    /* ----------------------------
       METRICS
    ---------------------------- */
    let rf = 0, axip = 0, latest = 0, latestCall = "";

    for (const st of mheardAll) {
      const port = Number(st.port);
      if (st.ts > latest) {
        latest = st.ts;
        latestCall = st.callSign;
      }
      if (port === RF_PORT) rf++;
      if (port === AXIP_PORT) axip++;
    }

    document.getElementById("w-links").innerText = links.length;
    document.getElementById("w-rf").innerText = rf;

    document.getElementById("w-last").innerText = latest
      ? `${latestCall} - ${Math.floor((Date.now()-latest)/60000)} mins ago`
      : "No data";

    /* Peers, uplinks and the health rollup are set from /metrics and
       /partners further down the page, so this page and the HAMNET one
       report the same thing. */


    renderNodes(allNodes);

  } catch (e) {
    setOffline();
    console.error("Dashboard offline exception triggered:", e);
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   NODES
---------------------------- */
function renderNodes(list) {
  const el = document.getElementById("nodes-container");
  if (!list.length) {
    el.innerHTML = "<p class='text-muted'>No nodes found</p>";
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = `
  <div class="nodes-grid">
    ${list.map(n => `
      <div class="node-card">
        <div style="font-weight:bold; color:#2c3e50;">
          ${n.callsign || n.Call || "Unknown"}
          ${n.alias || n.Alias ? `<span style="color:#e67e22;"> :${n.alias || n.Alias}</span>` : ""}
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join("")}
  </div>`;
}

document.getElementById("node-search").addEventListener("input", (e) => {
  const query = e.target.value.toUpperCase();
  const filtered = allNodes.filter(n => {
    const call = (n.callsign || n.Call || "").toUpperCase();
    const alias = (n.alias || n.Alias || "").toUpperCase();
    return call.includes(query) || alias.includes(query);
  });
  renderNodes(filtered);
});

fetchDashboardData();
</script>
